name: Rube's Last Piece
description: Complete a serial physical flight machine by choosing and aiming deflectors whose rebound energy must match calibrated receivers, observing each crosswind-affected trajectory, and iterating until the bell rings.
natural_language: Complete all three serial deflector links. Run the bench, study where the moving trajectory bends or misses, rewind, and revise until the final receiver rings the bell.

metadata.source_notes: Original interaction design informed by PHYRE's deterministic placement-and-rollout protocol, Virtual Tools' visible simulate/reset loop and matched geometric variants, and CREATE's multi-tool physical planning setup. No source level, art, code, or task template is copied.
metadata.notes: The browser and independent Python grader share fixed-step circle-to-segment collision, material restitution, calibrated impact-speed acceptance, crosswind flight, visible receiver contact, serial release contracts, and input-source binding. Full placement is restricted to the drawn station work zones and retains raw drag start/path/release evidence for grading.
